Wikipedia: Frey gained Mouen and British counter-attacks supported by tanks halted any further advance but could not retake it. Only a company-sized element of the division is documented that day; the row records that element's part in one connected action (Mouen/Tourville attack, Colleville thrust, evening British counter-attack), not a division-wide operation. It is kept as one row because the sources give no separate place or opponent for the pieces.
